dataset: SGL 2020 MagNav Challenge (USAF Cooperative Agreement FA8750-19-2-1000; Gnadt et al. arXiv:2007.12158); maps from MagNav.jl (ottawa_area_maps)

data/map_eastern_395.npz.info: Eastern Ontario magnetic anomaly map upward continued to 395 m above WGS-84 Ellipsoid. Flown and compiled near Ottawa, Ontario, Canada (UTM Zone 18N) by Sander Geophysics Ltd. (SGL). Filled in using k-nearest neighbors (k=3). Processed using MagNav.jl v1.2.0.
